headline: Huaico disaster response mobilizes government action
subheadline: President visits affected areas overseeing cleanup efforts.
content: The Peruvian government has been actively responding to recent landslides affecting over ninety-six homes and injuring fifteen individuals near Santa Eulalia. President Pedro Pablo Kuczynski visited the area to oversee relief operations led by the Ministry of Transportation and Communications using previously deployed machinery.

headline: Lava Jato Commission calls former presidents and officials
subheadline: To testify about corruption allegations involving major construction firms.
content: Former mayors Susana Villarán and Luis Castañeda will soon face questioning before Congress regarding their involvement in alleged corrupt practices linked to Brazilian company Odebrecht. This inquiry also includes summoning past Presidents including Alejandro Toledo who denies fleeing Peru amidst investigations.

headline: The founder of Sodalicio declared guilty within institution
subheadline: Public prosecutor archives charges against him due to lack of evidence.
content: Despite being labeled ‘guilty’ internally by its own members last April, legal actions against Luis Figari, founder of the religious organization Sodalicio, have stalled after prosecutors found insufficient proof supporting claims of abuse among other serious accusations.
